title: Eco-friendly synthesis of novel pyrazole derivatives and their anticancer and CDK2 inhibitory activities
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,46506-46522
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05212B, Paper

Samar A. Abubshait, Lamia H. T. Amin, Abeer M. El-Naggar, Mohamed G. Elbanna, Kurls E. Anwer
A series of 1-(2-pyridinyl)-4-aryl-1H-pyrazole-3,5-diamine derivatives (2–12) were designed and synthesized using a one-pot multicomponent reaction via both microwave-assisted and conventional techniques.
